name: @zipzap/api-client
description: GENERATED from the backend OpenAPI spec. Never hand-edit — regenerate.

scripts.//build: tsc does not emit .d.ts inputs to outDir, so dist/index.d.ts imports ./generated.js and never finds it. Every consumer then degrades to `any` silently — which is exactly what the hub console hit. Copy it explicitly.
scripts.build: pnpm generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp src/generated.d.ts dist/generated.d.ts
